name: GitHub Actions
summary: A GitHub Actions workflow step runs ogun to validate a workflow file or start a run of an approved version. GitHub calls Ogun; Ogun does not drive GitHub.

auth.label: Local agent credential (self-hosted runner on the ogund host)

fields.name: agent_name
fields.label: Credential name
fields.help: Created once on a terminal: ogun credentials add NAME --kind agent. Pass it with --credential or OGUN_CREDENTIAL.

auth.label: Ogun API token (any runner, through ogun-server)

fields.name: ogun_api_token
fields.label: Ogun API token
fields.help: A token a signed-in person creates, role viewer or editor. Keep it in Actions secrets, not in Ogun.

settings.name: ogun_home
settings.label: Ogun state directory
settings.help: As $OGUN_HOME, for a runner on the ogund host.

settings.name: profile
settings.label: Profile
settings.help: Profile whose daemon to reach; also OGUN_PROFILE.

settings.name: server_url
settings.label: Ogun server URL
settings.help: The public_url of ogun-server: an origin with no path. For a runner on another machine.

settings.name: workspace
settings.label: Workspace id
settings.help: Sent as x-ogun-workspace. A token belongs to one workspace, so this is rarely needed.

egress.note: GitHub calls Ogun. Nothing leaves the machine from Ogun for this connector.

notes: GitHub Actions calls Ogun and cannot approve. ogun validate, hash and diff run offline on any runner; starting a run needs a runner on the ogund host, or a public ogun-server. A run that needs an approval waits for a person on the Ogun CLI or in Studio.
